item: Row 288 batch 4: 96 more test files open their SQLite engines with the app's pragmas
summary: 131 bare create_engine calls in 96 test files (none touched by an open PR) now go through tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine, so they run with the app's foreign keys, WAL, busy timeout and cache settings; the converted files and every test file importing one of them pass (1928). The ratchet ceiling goes from 487 to 356 calls in 257 files. Test-only, no release line.
